profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software engineer at General Dynamics C4 Systems
profile.summary:
Over 12 years of experience in different areas of development life cycle - System testing, configuration management, and release management . I possess extensive knowledge in configuration identification and control, standards and procedures development, CM processes, configuration auditing, and CM training and advocacy. 

I have experience in software builds/releases of various cell phone platforms like iDEN, CDMA, TDMA, and GSM on several system including Winows, HP-Unix, Solaris, and Linux.

I have continuously demonstrated abilities to adapt to changes with projects with the right attitude and spirit, learn new tools, and develop/adjust processes as needed ensuring traceability of those changes, and validating the completeness of a product and its component.

I also have experience in designing and implementing automation solutions. I believe that good and flexible process, automation, communication, and metrics are the cornerstones of a software organization.

Specialties: Configuration Management
ClearCase
Subversion
RTC
ClearQuest/DDTS
Perl
CGI
Shell scripting
DOS batch scripting
Make
